text:
Ria Patel: Uploaded new mocks for the private setup preflight. Main asks: how we show scan progress for multiple hosts, and wording for failure states + retry UX. figma: https://figma.com/file/placeholder (see 'Host preflight' frame)

Sam K: Quick look — I prefer a host-row approach (list with inline status) over a single progress bar. Easier to triage which host failed at a glance.

Tara Gomez: Agree with Sam. Progress bar gives a false sense of precision for heterogeneous hosts. Show X/total + spinner for the active host.

Mike L: Accessibility note — we need aria-live updates for each host status change so SR users hear progress. Also don’t rely on color alone (icons / text status).

Nadia (UX): Copy nits: change 'Unreachable' -> "Can't reach host". For CTA, prefer short verbs: 'Try again' or 'Retry probe' (leaning toward 'Retry probe'). Add a small 'Why this might fail' link that opens KB.

Ria Patel: Nice. Also thinking of an inline error card per-host that surfaces 1) quick cause, 2) one-click retry, 3) actionable steps (open port example). Example snippet we might show inside the card: ```nc -vz <HOST> <PORT>``` and a tiny note 'run from a machine in the same network'.

Sam K: Prefer the per-host retry button vs a global rescan. Make the host-row button micro (icon + label) and show an inline spinner on that row during retry.

Mike L: Current behavior shows a full-page red banner 'Setup failed' if any host fails — feels alarmist. Suggest neutral header: 'Some checks failed' and collapseable per-host details.

Tara Gomez: Small UX detail — allow editing host nicknames inline (click-to-edit) so users can label machines. Truncate long hostnames in the row, show full on hover tooltip.

Nadia (UX): Contrast check — the current red on overlay fails AA for small text. I'll open a token PR with updated danger/attention contrast and send a screenshot.

Ria Patel: :thumbsup: for inline retry + per-host card + 'Some checks failed' header. For the error card copy, I'd like a 'Next steps' bullet list (1-2 short actions) and a small 'Contact support' link if they want help.

deploy-bot: deploy-preview build finished — https://deploy/preview/1234 (staging)

Sam K: :eyes: linking the figma + deploy preview will help QA validate visual changes.

Mike L: Also flagging a technical edge-case — flaky networks: repeated immediate retries can blow up probe logs and confuse rate limits. Add exponential backoff and cap retries in the UI (e.g., max 3 attempts) and show 'Last tried: 45s ago' beside the button.

Tara Gomez: ARIA detail: announce final summary when scan completes: 'Scan complete — 4 reachable, 1 unreachable' in an aria-live=polite region.

Nadia (UX): Focus management: when scan completes move keyboard focus to the summary element so keyboard users land where results are.

Ria Patel: I'll update mocks with: host-row retry button, per-host error card with 'Next steps', neutral summary banner, aria-live updates, and focus move. Planning to push an updated figma + deploy preview by EOD. Anything else?

Sam K: Add a small KB link text change suggestion: 'Try from a machine in your network' -> 'Try from a host in the same VPC' (less ambiguous).

Nadia (UX): +1

Ria Patel: Thanks all — tagging @design for final accessibility and copy pass. Will post a follow-up thread when mocks + preview are up.
